name: reclip
description_en: Download videos from almost any website. Lightweight, self-hosted media downloader with a clean web UI.
readme_excerpt: ReClip A self-hosted, open-source video and audio downloader with a clean web UI. Paste links from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, and 1000+ other sites — download as MP4 or MP3. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/419d3e50-c933-444b-8cab-a9724986ba05 Features - Download videos from 1000+ supported sites (via yt-dlp) - MP4 video or MP3 audio extraction - Quality/resolution picker - Bulk downloads — paste multiple URLs at once - Automatic URL deduplication - Clean, responsive UI —…
